_comment: Where each engine makes a model and loads its weights (ROADMAP M19 L7, entail/adapters/loaders.py): module -> the base class of its model loaders. Every subclass's own load_model is wrapped; a load_model that calls another counts as one load.
_comment_assembly: Where each engine assembles its model - the target and any draft model loaded and wired together (ROADMAP M22.2): module -> Class.method. A read of a parameter nothing wrote made inside it is settled when it ends: reported if the model still holds the parameter, withdrawn if the engine replaced it.
